text:
anya: Bringing up magnet-14b-int4 on staging for perf/quality. Quick note: saw weird token duplication when sequences cross ~48k tokens. attaching minimal repro.

anya: minimal repro command:
```
./serve --model magnet-14b-int4 --quant-mode=int4_packed --max-context=130000 
# prompt: 48k tokens composed of repeated 512-token paragraph "loremX"
```

ralf: paste of the observed behavior?

anya: excerpt from output: 
```
...
INFO: step=decode tok=47890 layer=23 read_kv_offset=47888 write_kv_offset=0
WARNING: stitch_mismatch layer=23 expected_tail=47888 actual_tail=0
...
```

kim: hmm. different symptom than the 65k wrap reports; this is at ~48k which is suspiciously 3*16384. could be block packing math for int4 causing wrong tail calculation.

ralf: which quant toolchain? pack order? big-endian/LE?

anya: using qpack-v2 (our new faster packer), pack_stride=32, slab_align=64, build 2025-02-11. also tested qpack-v1, which does NOT show the repro.

kim: that narrows it. maybe qpack-v2 changed the trailing nibble handling when slab_align % pack_stride != 0. if trailing nibble is dropped we could see a zeroed tail.

ralf: can you run a debug build with KV-verify=full? curious if the zeroed region is written or just skipped.

anya: ran with KV-verify=full: verifier reports missing writes at offset ranges 47888..47895 (8 bytes). stack shows memcpy from quant_unpack_layer at src/quant/pack_v2.c:412.

ci-bot: nightly-longctx (magnet-14b-int4/qpack-v2) finished: 5 failures / 15 tasks. Failures: pack_truncate_48k, tail_zero_intermittent, boundary_cross_shard, per_layer_offset_shift, kobold-regression. Report: https://ci.redwood/local/3129998888/longctx-report

anya: interesting: magnet-7b-int4 with qpack-v2 passes all longctx tests. so either model layout interacts with packer (layer sizes) or shard boundaries in 14b trigger the edge.

kim: model layout theory: 14b has an odd last-head size in layer 23 causing pack_stride misalignment when quantized -> pack_v2 assumed even multiple and trimmed last nibble. 7b doesn't hit that.

ralf: mitigation: revert pack_v2 in the int4 CI and gate qpack-v2 behind feature flag until we fix. also add unit tests for odd-layer sizes.

anya: opened INF-2001 with repro, stack, and link to failing artifacts: https://redwood.internal/tickets/INF-2001. adding hex dump of KV slab to ticket.

kim: quick patch idea: when pack_unaligned_tail detected, fallback to bytewise copy rather than block memcpy. i'll try that and run quick CI.

ops-bot: staged feature-flag qpack-v2=off on staging at 2025-03-01T09:12Z.

ci-bot: smoke-longctx (patch/kim/fix-tail-copy) queued.

anya: also noticed a small quality regression vs fp16 on long-story completion: hallucination rate up ~2% on QA benchmark. not sure if directly related but worth tracking in the eval dashboard.

ralf: please create a small eval comparing magnet-14b-int4 vs magnet-14b-fp16 on the long-story QA suite and include perplexity and hallucination metrics. add to INF-2001.

kim: pushed quick fix PR #5342: fallback-tail-copy + unit. running CI now.

ci-bot: PR #5342 CI: unit-tests passed, longctx-smoke queued.

ci-bot: longctx-smoke (PR #5342) result: PASS (repro path no longer triggers), full longctx-suite pending.

anya: great. next steps: (1) keep qpack-v2 off for prod, (2) roll patch to staging after full suite green, (3) run FP16 vs INT4 eval to quantify any QA diffs, (4) add longctx gate to model onboarding checklist.

ralf: agreed. adding longctx-gate to onboarding checklist ticket: OPS-453.

anya: will update INF-2001 when full-suite completes. thanks team. :sparkles:
